'''''Talon 1''''' was the designation of the lead starfighter of [[Talon Squadron (New Republic)|Talon Squadron]], a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], and was flown by [[Brevet]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Myn Donos]].

==History==
Talon Squadron was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] starfighter squadron formed shortly after the [[Battle of Thyferra]]. It was commanded by [[Brevet]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Myn Donos]], who flew the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing]] designated ''Talon 1''.

Due to false information given by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]], Talon Squadron was defeated during an [[Ambush at Gravan Seven|ambush]] at [[Gravan Seven]], with all members lost except ''Talon 1''. Due to such heavy losses, Talon Squadron was decommissioned by the New Republic.

==Behind the scenes==
In the WizKids' game, ''[[Star Wars PocketModel TCG: Base Set]]'', ''Talon 1'' appears as a representation of Talon Squadron in the [[Star_Wars_PocketModel_TCG:_Base_Set#Imperial_Power-up_Pack|''Imperial Power-up Pack'']] promotional release.
